Interface TtioRansNative.ContextResolver

Enclosing class:
TtioRansNative
Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public static interface TtioRansNative.ContextResolver
Per-symbol context resolver used by TtioRansNative.decodeBlockStreaming(byte[], int, int[][], int[][], byte[], int, TtioRansNative.ContextResolver).

Implementations must derive a context id from the current symbol index i and the previously decoded symbol prevSym (0 when i == 0). Must be deterministic. The returned int is treated as an unsigned 16-bit context id; it must be less than the nContexts passed to TtioRansNative.decodeBlockStreaming(byte[], int, int[][], int[][], byte[], int, TtioRansNative.ContextResolver), or the native call returns TTIO_RANS_ERR_PARAM.

Performance reality (Task 26c): per-symbol JNI dispatch has a JVM context-switch cost that is much higher than ctypes callback dispatch in Python (which itself was a wash with pure-Python in Task 26b). For realistic block sizes the streaming path is expected to be SLOWER than the pure-Java V2 decoder. The binding is shipped as infrastructure; codec callers gate it behind an opt-in path with a safe pure-Java fallback.
